7940-the-native-born-or-the-rajah-s-peop.title: The Rajah'S People
7940-the-native-born-or-the-rajah-s-peop.creator: Unknown
7940-the-native-born-or-the-rajah-s-peop.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Her companion made no immediate answer. She stood by the wall, her shoulders slightly hunched, her hands clasped before her in an attitude of fixed, sullen defiance. What her features expressed it was impossible to tell, since they were hidden by the deep shadow in which she had taken up her position.

arxiv-2109-04540.title: Free-fermion multiply-excited eigenstates and their experimental signatures in 1D arrays of two-level atoms
arxiv-2109-04540.creator: Yu-Xiang Zhang, Klaus Mølmer
arxiv-2109-04540.description: Abstract One-dimensional (1D) subwavelength atom arrays display multiply-excited subradiant eigenstates which are reminiscent of free fermions. So far, these states have been associated with subradiant states with decay rates ∝ N − 3 \propto N^{-3} , with N N the number of atoms, which fundamentally prevents detection of their fermionic features by optical means.

arxiv-2301-05970.title: Hawking radiation and entropy of a BTZ black hole with minimum length
arxiv-2301-05970.creator: M. A. Anacleto, F. A. Brito, E. Passos, José L. Paulino, A. T. N. Silva, J. Spinelly
arxiv-2301-05970.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by M. A. Anacleto, F. A. Brito, E. Passos, José L. Paulino, A. T. N. Silva, J. Spinelly. In this paper we consider a BTZ black hole with minimum length which has been introduced through the probability density of the ground state of the hydrogen atom. We analyzed the effect of the minimum length by calculating the thermodynamic quantities such as temperature and entropy and verified the stability of the black hole by computing the specific heat capacity.

arxiv-2401-00736.title: Diffusion Models, Image Super-Resolution And Everything: A Survey PubID: pubid: 0000–0000/00$00.00 © 2021 IEEE
arxiv-2401-00736.creator: Brian B. Moser, Arundhati S. Shanbhag, Federico Raue, Stanislav Frolov, Sebastian Palacio, Andreas Dengel
arxiv-2401-00736.description: Abstract Diffusion Models (DMs) have disrupted the image Super-Resolution (SR) field and further closed the gap between image quality and human perceptual preferences. They are easy to train and can produce very high-quality samples that exceed the realism of those produced by previous generative methods.

arxiv-2510-26115.title: Quenched coalescent for diploid population models with selfing and overlapping generations
arxiv-2510-26115.creator: Louis Wai-Tong Fan, Maximillian Newman, John Wakeley
arxiv-2510-26115.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Louis Wai-Tong Fan, Maximillian Newman, John Wakeley. We introduce a general diploid population model with self-fertilization and possible overlapping generations, and study the genealogy of a sample of n n genes as the population size N N tends to infinity. Unlike traditional approach in coalescent theory which considers the unconditional (annealed) law of the gene genealogies averaged over the population pedigree, here we study the conditional (quenched) law of gene genealogies given the pedigree.

arxiv-2601-09214.title: Tightness of the maximum of branching random walk in random environment and zero-crossings of solutions to discrete parabolic differential equations
arxiv-2601-09214.creator: Jiří Černý, Flavio Dalessi
arxiv-2601-09214.description: Abstract . We study branching random walk on ℤ \mathbb{Z} in a bounded i.i.d. random environment. For this process, we prove that, for almost every realization of the environment, the distributions of the maximally displaced particle (re-centered around their medians) are tight.

europmc-pmc10495961.title: PyMC: a modern, and comprehensive probabilistic programming framework in Python.
europmc-pmc10495961.creator: Abril-Pla O, Andreani V, Carroll C, Dong L, Fonnesbeck CJ, Kochurov M, Kumar R, Lao J, Luhmann CC, Martin OA, Osthege M, Vieira R, Wiecki T, Zinkov R.

It offers an intuitive, readable syntax that is close to the natural syntax statisticians use to describe models. PyMC leverages the symbolic computation...

pmc-10543836.title: Mechanisms and predictors of menses resumption once normal weight is reached in anorexia nervosa
pmc-10543836.creator: Bogdan Galusca, Aurélia Gay, Gwenaëlle Belleton, Martin Eisinger, Catherine Massoubre, François Lang, Dominique Grouselle, Bruno Estour, Natacha Germain
pmc-10543836.description: BackgroundIn cases of Anorexia Nervosa (AN), achieving weight gain recovery beyond the lower limits set by the World Health Organization and normalizing classical nutritional markers appears to be essential for most patients. However, this is not always adequate to restore menstrual cycles.

pmc-10652747.title: Cell-free DNA measurement of three genomes after allogeneic MSC therapy in kidney transplant recipients indicates early cell death of infused MSC
pmc-10652747.creator: Geertje J. Dreyer, Jos JM. Drabbels, Johan W. de Fijter, Cees van Kooten, Marlies EJ. Reinders, Sebastiaan Heidt
pmc-10652747.description: IntroductionMesenchymal stromal cell (MSC) therapy is a promising treatment that allows for drug minimization in clinical kidney transplantation. While it is thought that MSCs rapidly go into apoptosis after infusion, clinical evidence for this is scarce since methods to detect cell death of infused cells in vivo are lacking.

pmc-10753556.title: Synthesis and Characterization of a Novel DOPO-Based Flame Retardant Intermediate and Its Flame Retardancy as a Polystyrene Intrinsic Flame Retardant
pmc-10753556.creator: Shaobo Dong, Yazhen Wang, Li Liu, Hongge Jia, Yu Zang, Liwu Zu, Tianyu Lan, Jun Wang
pmc-10753556.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The research on intrinsic flame retardant has become a hot topic in the field of flame retardant. The synthesis of reactive flame-retardant monomer is one of the effective methods to obtain an intrinsic flame retardant.

pmc-11319458.title: Assessment of health risks associated with heavy metal contamination in selected fish and crustacean species from Temsah Lake, Suez Canal
pmc-11319458.creator: Alaa M Younis, Said Hanafy, Eman M Elkady, Abdullah H Alluhayb, Fahd M Alminderej
pmc-11319458.description: Marine pollution caused by heavy metals has emerged as a significant environmental concern, garnering increased attention in recent years. The accumulation of heavy metals in the tissues of marine organisms poses substantial threats to both marine ecosystems and human populations that rely on seafood as a primary food source.

pmc-11447269.title: Genomic adaptation to small population size and saltwater consumption in the critically endangered Cat Ba langur
pmc-11447269.creator: Liye Zhang, Neahga Leonard, Rick Passaro, Mai Sy Luan, Pham Van Tuyen, Le Thi Ngoc Han, Nguyen Huy Cam, Larry Vogelnest, Michael Lynch, Amanda E Fine, Nguyen Thi Thanh Nga, Nguyen Van Long, Benjamin M Rawson, Alison Behie, Truong Van Nguyen, Minh D Le, Tilo Nadler, Lutz Walter, Tomas Marques-Bonet,
pmc-11447269.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Many mammal species have declining populations, but the consequences of small population size on the genomic makeup of species remain largely unknown. We investigated the evolutionary history, genetic load and adaptive potential of the Cat Ba langur (Trachypithecus poliocephalus), a primate species endemic to Vietnam’s famous Ha Long Bay and with less than 100 living individuals one of the most threatened primates in the world.

pmc-11477200.title: Impact of Gut Microbiota and SCFAs in the Pathogenesis of PCOS and the Effect of Metformin Therapy
pmc-11477200.creator: Evgenii Kukaev, Ekaterina Kirillova, Alisa Tokareva, Elena Rimskaya, Natalia Starodubtseva, Galina Chernukha, Tatiana Priputnevich, Vladimir Frankevich, Gennady Sukhikh, Jim Parker
pmc-11477200.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a complex disorder that impacts both the endocrine and metabolic systems, often resulting in infertility, obesity, insulin resistance, and cardiovascular complications. The aim of this study is to investigate the role of intestinal flora and its metabolites, particularly short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), in the development of PCOS, and to assess the effects of metformin therapy on these components.

pmc-12652806.title: Moon Jellyfish Mucin and Collagen Attenuate Catabolic Activity in Chondrocytes but Show Limited Efficacy in an Osteoarthritis Rat Model
pmc-12652806.creator: Haruka Omura, Eriko Toyoda, Takayuki Baba, Ryoka Uchiyama, Masahiko Watanabe, Masato Sato
pmc-12652806.description: Cartilage regeneration has long been a major challenge in the treatment of osteoarthritis (OA). Aiming to develop a simple outpatient treatment for knee OA, we have demonstrated the potential of combining Nomura’s jellyfish mucin (JM) and hyaluronic acid (HA) to contribute to cartilage repair and regeneration in chondrocytes.

pmc-12682601.title: A Novel Mutation of CADHERIN (CDH15) in an Iranian Boy With Borderline Intelligence Without Dysmorphism—A Case Report
pmc-12682601.creator: Mahmoud Reza Ashrafi, Ali Nikkhah, Morteza Heidari, Solmaz Aziz‐Ahari, Zahra Rezaei, Ali Rashidi‐Nezhad, Golazin Shahbodagh Khan, Roya Sinaei, Shiva Bayat
pmc-12682601.description: This case study presents a case of genetic intellectual disability that has been transmitted from a seemingly normal mother to her son, which exemplifies the occurrence of reduced penetrance of the condition, a mechanism already known to be implicated in the transmission of autosomal dominant neurological conditions.

pmc-13130886.title: Single-cell RNA sequencing of leukocytes at the maternal-fetal interface in physiological and pathological Nodal-deficient pregnancies
pmc-13130886.creator: Sarah Yull, Alain Pacis, Laura Girardet, Daniel Dufort
pmc-13130886.description: Leukocytes at the maternal-fetal interface have critical functions during pregnancy in the prevention of maternal reactivity towards fetal alloantigens, suppression of excess inflammation and promotion of placental angiogenesis. Failed maternal immune adaptations to pregnancy can lead to placental insufficiency and the development of severe reproductive complications.

pmc-13627407.title: Epidemiological characteristics of tuberculosis among migrant populations and key predictors of migratory cases in Zhejiang Province
pmc-13627407.creator: Zhengwei Liu, Jiani Miao, Rongrong Qu, Can Chen, Mengsha Chen, Jiaxing Qi, Wenkai Zhou, Huihui Zhang, Mingwu Zhang, Bin Chen, Liqun Fang, Shigui Yang
pmc-13627407.description: ObjectivesPopulation mobility poses challenges to tuberculosis (TB) control. As a major destination for internal migrants in China, Zhejiang Province bears a substantial burden of migrant TB cases. This study aimed to characterize TB epidemiology in Zhejiang Province and identify key predictors of migratory TB cases.
